name: Shenzhen Longtech Smart Control Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Longtech Smart Control Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, production, and sales of intelligent controllers and products in China and internationally. It offers energy storage products, such as industrial and commercial energy storage, outdoor energy storage, home energy storage, BMS/battery pack, and off-grid energy storage products; automotive electronics, including automotive heat pipe, electric actuators, and electromechanically control module products; and consumer products, such as home appliances, personal care, cleaning, outdoor, medical, and robotic products.
